caseno: Civil Rule No. 379(f) of 2002 with FA No. 841 of 1991
parties:
Sonali Bank ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Sheikh Anis Uddin Ahmed ------ Opposite Party
full_judgment: 4. In the application for substitution it has been stated that "but the appellant could not know the same immediately but subsequently when the appellant came to learn about the same." We find that there is lack of mentioning as to the date of death of the deceased. Thereafter, in the application for substitution it is stated as "after collecting the name of the heirs of the deceased, sent the same to his engaged lawyer, Mr ABM Khairul Hoque for the purpose of filing the application for substitution but due to unknown reason, (which is very significant) application for substitution of the heirs of the deceased was not filed by the then engaged lawyer Mr ABM Khairul Hoque." Thereafter, the application runs as "after his appointment as a Judge of the High Court, Mr Shamsuddin Babul replaced Mr ABM Khairul Hoque, by letter dated 12-11-1998 and though the case record was handed over to him, but due to unknown reason (which is very significant) papers relating to substitution of the heirs of the deceased had not been sent with the record and the appellant even did not intimate about the matter to Mr Shamsuddin Babul thinking that since they sent the list of the heirs of the deceased to Mr ABM Khairul Hoque, he must have filed the application for substitution." And in this way, 9 years 5 months 5 days delay has occurred in filing the application. The reason for causing delay is unsatisfactory and not covered by any hypothecation. The conduct of the filing lawyer is not reasonable and not covered by any norms of practice as the delay is absolutely inordinate. The appellant may sue the filing conducting lawyer for the loss but on such application which does not disclose the particulars even to the date of knowledge of the date of death of the deceased, respondent No.1, for unexplained unknown reason according to the broad principle of law of limitation, the vested right accrued to the other side after prescribed period of limitation cannot be wiped out. On such type of application unusual long delay of 9 years 5 months 5 days cannot be condoned.
